messages:
jane: FYI customer reported intermittent high p99 latency on /v1/generate around 2026-03-10 14:00 UTC. They attached a HAR but no request IDs. Can we outline exactly what to ask for so CS can send a clean repro bundle?

sam: Ask for the Request ID header (x-request-id) or trace token. Those are in the response headers and the SDK logs. Also need the project/org id, route name, and the time window.

jane: I'll paste a short checklist here for the customer. Feedback welcome.

maria: Quick note for mobile customers: our Android SDK logs show the request id as `request_id=...` and iOS logs as `X-Request-ID: ...` when debug logging is enabled. Tell them how to enable debug logs in the SDK.

jane: (to customer) Hi — can you send the following so we can correlate your calls to our traces:
- project id / org id used on the request
- exact timestamps (UTC) for the bad requests
- the x-request-id response header values (one or more) OR the entire response headers for a single failing call
- a minimal curl reproduction (see example below) OR a short HAR with full request/response entries
- SDK logs if using an SDK (attach the log file)
- route name or model name you called and the SDK + version

Please attach everything as a single ZIP. If you can't find the headers: in the Console go to Activity -> API requests -> search by time window, click an entry and you'll see response headers incl. x-request-id.

sam: Example curl they can use to reproduce and capture response headers: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  -v 2>&1 | tee curl-output.txt
```
Look for a header like: `x-request-id: 01HABC2DEF34` in curl-output.txt.

maria: Node / Python snippets to log response header quickly: 
```js
// Node fetch
const res = await fetch(url, opts);
console.log('x-request-id:', res.headers.get('x-request-id'));
```
```py
# Python requests
r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print('x-request-id:', r.headers.get('x-request-id'))
```

tyler: For mobile: Android (adb) you can filter logs: `adb logcat | grep RequestId` — we log `RequestId=<id>` when debug enabled. iOS: use Console.app and search for "X-Request-ID" or enable SDK debug mode.

jane: Also ask them to mark which calls exhibited high latency vs timeouts and include the client-side duration vs total duration (client timestamp). If they used a proxy or gateway, include that config — proxy trims headers sometimes.

support-bot: Reminder: when attaching HAR, remove PII. We only need headers/payload & timing.

sam: If they can’t reproduce, ask for a minimal non-sensitive payload and we’ll run it from our side — include the exact curl + token (we can generate a short-lived test token if they prefer not to share their token).

jane: OK I'll send this checklist to the customer and request a ZIP with: HAR, curl-output.txt (or curl command), SDK logs, project id, timeframe, and one example x-request-id. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
